name: gadget-market
description: Gadget Market — gadget & tech-accessories shop (Dhaka) on one Cloudflare Worker (Hono + D1 + KV + R2)

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run build && wrangler d1 execute DB --local -c worker/wrangler.toml --file=./dist-seed/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run build && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote -c worker/wrangler.toml --file=./dist-seed/seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.toml
